releaseNotes:
- The Demo offers hands-on guided learning with resumable editing and publishing practice.
- Studio improves dialogue, choice and phone-message editing with previews of the selected content.
- Start an original project from an idea, retain its conversation, and inspect Agent file changes in readonly diffs.
- Projects gain story-aware title suggestions and history, plus shared-project checkout and safe synchronization.
- Voice casting explains selection methods, supports uploaded recording auditions and cloning, and improves narrow layouts and upload status.
- New outfits and expression sprites can be produced and inspected before script usage; chat image cards open in a larger preview and remain available after restart.
- Account costs distinguish confirmed and pending usage while keeping the interface focused.
releaseNotesZh:
- Demo 提供分阶段动手引导，可暂停并继续编辑与发布演练。
- Studio 改善对白、选项和手机消息编辑，并准确预览当前选中内容。
- 可以从一句创作想法开始原创项目，保留项目对话，并查看 Agent 改动文件与只读差异。
- 作品支持结合故事的名字建议和历史记录，协作项目可检出与安全同步。
- 配音页面说明选角方式，支持上传录音试听与克隆，并改善窄分栏布局和上传状态。
- 尚未用于剧本的新服装和剧情立绘也能生成、查看；聊天图片卡片可放大，并在重启后保留预览。
- 账户费用区分已确认与待结算用量，界面减少无关诊断信息。
